message: I remember the time I thought I was ready for a big storm. I had my flashlight, extra batteries, and even a few snacks — but I forgot to check the weather app. The night before, I was all set for a cozy evening, only to wake up to a surprise winter wonderland! I ended up spending the day watching the snow pile up, bundled in a blanket with a cup of cocoa. It was like an unexpected snow day, but with a sprinkling of chaos. Lesson learned: sometimes being ‘prepared’ just means being ready for the unexpected. 🥴
